kanban.title: Start on the board
kanban.body: The Kanban board is the daily dispatch view. Drag cards or open a request to assign work.

new-request.title: Create a request
new-request.body: New request walks through the customer, product, warranty, and technician assignment.

notifications.title: Stay on alerts
notifications.body: Notifications collect overdue jobs, low stock, and assignment notes. Open them from the bell in the header.

reports.title: Reports live here
reports.body: Open Management when you need profit, parts, warranty, or technician reports.

management.title: Management tools
management.body: Inventory, technician schedule, audit log, duplicate customers, and backup settings stay in this lower section so the daily list stays short.

settings.title: Backup settings
settings.intro: Daily database dumps are configured on the server. This page only explains how they work — nothing here changes live data.
settings.backupBody: When BACKUP_ENABLED is true, the API writes a daily pg_dump into BACKUP_DIR.
settings.backupEnv: Set BACKUP_ENABLED, BACKUP_DIR, and BACKUP_RETAIN_DAYS in server/.env.
settings.backupManual: Run npm run db:backup from the repo root to take a dump by hand.
settings.backupRetain: Dumps older than BACKUP_RETAIN_DAYS (default 30) are removed after a successful run.
settings.restoreBody: Stop the API, restore the .sql file with psql into DATABASE_URL, then start the API again. Do not run db:reset after a restore.
settings.stockBody: The block-zero-stock toggle lives with spare parts in Inventory.
settings.staffBody: Staff, roles, passwords and pay rates.
settings.rulesBody: Deadlines and estimate rules apply system-wide.
settings.legalDaysHint: Past this limit the job is flagged as legally overdue.
settings.repairWarrantyDaysHint: If the same fault returns in this period, the repair is free.
settings.estimateDaysHint: The estimate expires after this period if the customer does not respond.
settings.storageDaysHint: How long a finished item is kept at the counter.
settings.requireEstimate: Require an approved estimate before paid repair
settings.requireEstimateTip: When on, the technician cannot start a paid repair until the customer approves the estimate.
settings.serviceBody: Time windows customers pick from, escalating overdue jobs, the low-rating alert and summaries.
settings.visitCapacityHint: No more than this can be booked.
settings.rescheduleLimit: How often a customer may move a visit
settings.rescheduleLimitHint: After that only the service can move it.
settings.cancelBeforeHint: Closer than this, a customer cannot change the visit.
settings.lowRatingHint: A rating at or below this alerts the admins at once.
settings.escalationHoursHint: An overdue job is raised again with the admins after this long.
settings.escalationUrgentHint: After this long the job becomes urgent automatically.
settings.expiryNoticeHint: The customer is told this many days before the warranty ends. 0 turns it off.
settings.requireFiscal: Fiscal receipt number for every payment
settings.requireFiscalTip: When on, a payment cannot be saved without a receipt number.
settings.weeklyDigestTip: Every Monday morning the admins get last week's summary (bell and Telegram).

sections.p: RIZO Service is the after-sales installation and repair service for RIZO products. This policy explains how your personal data is used on the website and in the apps.

Your name, phone number, address (and your location if you share it), the products you bought, serial numbers, service requests, photos and messages you send, payments, ratings and comments. A technician's name is shown to you by first name only.

To provide the service (installation, repair, warranty), to contact you (SMS, Telegram, in-app messages), to handle estimates and payments, and for the records the law requires. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising.

Only authorised RIZO staff, depending on their role. The technician working for you sees your name, phone and address. Messages travel through an SMS provider and Telegram; online payments go through Payme or Click.
Photos of the product and the signature at hand-over are attached to the request and used only to confirm the service.

For the warranty period and as long as the law requires for accounts. If you ask us to erase your data, your name, phone and address are removed; requests and payments stay for the accounts, without a name.

On the “My account” page you can download everything we hold about you as a file, choose how you are messaged (SMS or Telegram) and ask us to erase your data. To correct a mistake, contact the service.
Data travels over HTTPS, staff access depends on their role, and important changes are logged. Staff can switch on two-step sign-in.
For questions, use the contact details on the “Service centres” page. If this policy changes, it will be updated on this page.
The website and apps are for requesting and following installation, repair and warranty service for RIZO products.
Keep your sign-in details secret. You are responsible for what is done through your account. If someone used it without your knowledge, tell the service.
A paid repair starts after you approve the estimate. You choose the optional lines yourself. When the work is done the balance is paid; until it is paid in full the device may be held back.

The warranty follows the product's terms and usually runs from the installation date. Warranty extension plans are paid and take effect once the payment is accepted. The repair deadlines set by law are kept.
You can choose a visit time and move it a limited number of times. When the visit is close, changes go through the service. If nobody is there to meet us, a repeat trip may be charged.
Give correct details (address, phone, serial number), let the technician reach the product and send photos of the fault.
The service is responsible for the quality of its work and its warranty duties within the law. Damage caused by misuse or by wrong information from the customer is not covered by the warranty.
These terms may be updated; the new version is published on this page. Disputes are settled under the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
